purpose: Teach: 連合/入手/出場/総務/プレス/出荷/故障/名義

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界、本気で、絶対、連合、絶対、研究、絶対、参加しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren, I need you to commit fully to the academic alliance research project. I'm asking you seriously.
lines.style: Firm, direct tone with quiet weight behind it. Speaks the young man's name like he's being held accountable. Even pacing, steady eye contact. The confidence of someone who believes in the ask.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外文献の、本気で、絶対、入手、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making real progress on sourcing the overseas literature. Thank you for the push.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine, not over-performed. Slight nod-quality to the opening. Warm undertone — he means the gratitude. Steady, measured pace. The relief of being trusted with something that matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国際学会、本気で、絶対、出場、絶対、お前が、絶対、決定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The international conference — I need you to make the final call on whether we submit. Don't defer to anyone else.
lines.style: Clear authority without harshness. Light emphasis on 「you」 — this is Ren's decision to own. Slightly slower than normal conversation. The tone of someone who knows what he's asking isn't easy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大学の、本気で、絶対、総務、絶対、部、絶対、と、絶対、調整中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm coordinating with the university's administrative office right now. I appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly deferential but not apologetic. Quiet energy — he's working on this. The 「right now」 carries a small note of effort. Warm, not stiff. Trailing off slightly, like he's already turning back to the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文発表、本気で、絶対、プレス、絶対、対応、絶対、教授と、絶対、相談しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: On the paper presentation and press handling — talk to your advisor before you commit to anything. Get his read first.
lines.style: Experienced advice, delivered without condescension. Slight lean forward energy. The pace slows on the second half, like he wants to make sure this lands. Protective, not doubting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、出荷、絶対、と、絶対、いえる、絶対、印刷、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The paper's ready for print and we're moving forward with the publication timeline. Thank you for guiding this.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. The opening 「Yes」 is crisp, confident. Mid-tone, no tremor. He's past the worry stage now. Slight warmth on the gratitude — he's recognizing the mentorship without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実験装置の、本気で、絶対、故障、絶対、点検しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the experimental apparatus for any damage or wear before you run it. Don't assume it's fine.
lines.style: Practical, protective sharpness. Clipped rhythm on the instruction — this is important. The tone of someone who's seen things go wrong because someone skipped this step. Not harsh, just non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、名義、絶対、教授と、絶対、確認しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Done. I've confirmed the author attribution on the paper with the professor. Everything is clear.
lines.style: Crisp, almost final. The 「Done」 carries closure. Steady, assured voice. No apology, no hedging — he's handled it. Slight breath after 「professor」 before the final affirmation. The tone of someone checking the last box.
